evidence: We are working to expand our use of AI to drive efficiencies and enhance productivity, including in the areas of finance, procurement, marketing and IT support.
In early 2025, we implemented secure enterprise versions of Microsoft Co-Pilot and Enterprise ChatGPT within our organization.
We also implemented an Open Text AI solution to automate sales order ingestion into SAP.
In 2026, we plan to start working with enterprise Claude Code for non-proprietary coding work and to develop AI Agents in our secure enterprise ChatGPT environment for conducting data analysis.
We have published an enhanced policy with additional guardrails to address the AI-related risks associated with data privacy, cybersecurity and copyright and intellectual property protections.
ai_positioning.summary: AVNS adopte l'IA en interne pour améliorer ses opérations (finance, procurement, IT support) via des solutions d'entreprise sécurisées (Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude), avec des plans d'expansion en 2026 incluant des AI Agents pour l'analyse de données.
